title: Snowsports School Deposit, Balance and Instalment Terms
content:
A Snowsports School booking takes the product's deposit share of the tuition when it is recorded, and the rest falls due later.

## When the balance is collected

The balance is collected no later than the product's balance period counted in calendar days from the day the booking was recorded.

Calendar days are counted forward from the anchor date, the anchor date itself counting as day zero, every day of the week counting alike, and a calendar day is never mixed with a full 24-hour period; where the resulting boundary falls on a date that does not exist in the target month, the last day of that month is used. The day the booking was recorded is read from the booking record, matched by the booking reference; collection on the due day itself is within the period.

## Products with nothing left to collect

A product whose deposit is the whole price has no balance to collect.

## Scheduled instalments

Where the product offers scheduled instalments, the balance may be divided instead of collected at once, and the booking is still firm while the schedule runs.

## A balance not collected in time

A balance that is not collected by its due date puts the place at risk: the place is released back to the waiting list, and where it is taken by another household the booking is given up on the late cancellation terms rather than held open.

## Boundary readings of the balance period

Take a product whose balance period is 14 calendar days and a booking recorded on the third of a month. Counting the third as day zero, the balance falls due on the seventeenth.

| Day of collection | Reading |
| --- | --- |
| the sixteenth | inside the period |
| the seventeenth | the due day itself, and so inside the period |
| the eighteenth | the due date has passed, and the place is at risk |

Where a product's balance period is 0 calendar days, the day the booking is recorded is itself the due day.

The deposit shares, balance periods, instalment availability and refund processing times these terms turn on are published product by product on the Snowsports School tariff.
